name: RepairBrief
description: Private technician brief snapshot owned by the coordinator. Evidence is minimized and bounded, with source and status labels. JSON fields contain no raw transcript, phone number in share text, credentials, security codes, provider response, diagnosis, or repair recommendation.

repair_job_id.description: ID of the owner-created RepairJob this current brief belongs to

call_attempt_id.description: ID of the related private CallAttempt when one exists; empty before local preparation

call_completion_status.description: Bounded call completion state such as not_started, in_progress, completed, failed, canceled, or unknown

readiness_status.description: Truthful business-readiness assessment: blocked, needs_follow_up, unknown, or ready_for_technician_review

human_review_state.description: Separate owner review state: not_reviewed, reviewed, or needs_follow_up

human_review_note.description: Bounded owner review note only, scrubbed for phone details and security-code language

reviewed_at.description: ISO timestamp for the latest owner review state, or empty when not reviewed

evidence_json.description: Bounded JSON array of the five required evidence items with allowlisted key, source, status, value, and optional excerpt; no raw transcript or secret data

blockers_json.description: Bounded JSON array of explicitly reported visit blockers with source and optional excerpt; never inferred from missing data

follow_up_json.description: Bounded JSON array of explicit unresolved material details reported by the call, with source call_reported; no raw transcript, phone number, credential, or security code

follow_up_review_json.description: Private bounded coordinator review metadata for current call-reported follow-ups only, matched by sanitized item key and value; stores open or reviewed status and an unverified short note

safe_summary.description: Bounded generated copy-safe summary with phone details omitted and coordinator content labeled unverified
